limitations: No deployed URL exists, so headers, cookies, storage, third parties, field performance and production network behaviour were not tested.
Automatic meeting notes can contain transcription errors and do not prove the legal nature of the service.
No legal operator, establishment, enterprise size, contract formation, terms, rights package or approved legal texts were supplied.

Madrid and Barcelona/Catalonia are observed target locations, but establishment, recipient, place-of-performance and classified-activity facts are missing; no exhaustive BOCM/DOGC or municipal inventory was performed.
The exact profile and contact design is not frozen, so this audit does not conclude whether GDPR Article 9 data are processed or inferred, or whether an Article 35 DPIA is required.
No visual target was selected among three incompatible mockups.
The audited working tree is not frozen: checkpoint_sha, tree_sha and effective_at must be populated only after final artifact synchronisation and commit.
This is a technical control assessment, not legal advice or certification.
